summary: Iteration 5 verified the new not_responding-on-trigger + reminder-scheduling + cancel-on-safe-or-dismiss feature end-to-end. All 4 requested flows PASS on the Expo web preview (viewport 390x844) with page.route intercepting POST https://safequake.onrender.com/api/status. Code checks in index.tsx, alert.tsx, checkin.ts, reminders.ts all match the requested contract (postStatus not_responding + ensureNotificationSetup + scheduleCheckInReminders BEFORE router.push('/alert'); cancelCheckInReminders on both I'm Safe and Dismiss; iOS interruptionLevel 'critical' + allowCriticalAlerts:true; Android channel 'quakeguard-critical' with AndroidImportance.MAX). No hardcoded lat/lng in checkin.ts. Regression: home hero, 4 tip cards, sticky trigger button all render.

test_flow_results.flow: Home -> Trigger: single not_responding POST fires BEFORE /alert visible
test_flow_results.evidence: alert-screen not present pre-click; after click exactly 1 POST captured with status='not_responding', deviceId='qg-1784712100056-n84t4ant' (non-empty); alert-screen then became visible.

test_flow_results.flow: Alert -> I'm Safe: safe POST with fanned coords, same deviceId, success toast, auto-nav to Home
test_flow_results.evidence: Warm GPS fix log '[QuakeGuard] using warm GPS fix -> 35.8916 14.4658 +/- 10 m'. safe POST body has latitude=35.8916, longitude=14.4658, lat=35.8916, lng=14.4658, lon=14.4658, accuracy=10, coords={lat/lng/acc}, coordinates=[14.4658,35.8916], geo={type:Point,coordinates:[14.4658,35.8916]}, location={latitude,longitude,accuracy,error:null}. deviceId matches first POST. alert-success-toast appeared. Response status 200 (mocked).

test_flow_results.flow: Full flow ordering: exactly 2 POSTs — not_responding then safe
Home -> Trigger -> Alert -> Dismiss: 1 not_responding POST fired, 0 additional POSTs on Dismiss, nav returns to Home
test_flow_results.evidence: Fresh page reload. After trigger: 1 POST (not_responding). After Dismiss tap + 3s wait: delta=0 additional POSTs. alert-screen removed from DOM; trigger-alert-btn visible on Home (1 element).

index.tsx lines 19-24 import postStatus/ensureNotificationSetup/scheduleCheckInReminders/cancelCheckInReminders. handleTrigger (lines 63-86) calls postStatus({status:'not_responding'}), then IIFE runs ensureNotificationSetup->scheduleCheckInReminders, then router.push('/alert'). alert.tsx handleImSafe (lines 214-224) calls postStatus({status:'safe', location, battery}) and awaits cancelCheckInReminders() on success. Dismiss button (lines 326-330) calls cancelCheckInReminders().catch(...) before router.back(). reminders.ts uses SchedulableTriggerInputTypes.TIME_INTERVAL, content.interruptionLevel='critical' (line 83), Android channelId='quakeguard-critical' + AndroidImportance.MAX (line 24-27) + priority MAX (line 87). requestPermissionsAsync passes ios.allowCriticalAlerts:true (line 50). checkin.ts contains no numeric coord literals (only reads from location arg).

test_flow_results.flow: Regression: home hero + 4 tip cards + sticky trigger
test_flow_results.evidence: testIDs visible: system-status-banner, tip-card-drop, tip-card-cover, tip-card-hold on, tip-card-after, trigger-alert-btn.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor (not blocking): expo-notifications on web logs a warning ('Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web') and 'shadow*' style props deprecation warnings — both are expected on web preview and do not affect native builds. iOS critical-alerts entitlement can only be verified on a real native build (skipped as instructed).

handleTrigger sets triggering=true then does NOT await the ensureNotificationSetup+scheduleCheckInReminders IIFE (fire-and-forget). This is intentional so navigation isn't blocked, and observed behaviour is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. deviceId auto-generated by getDeviceId() and persisted in AsyncStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web-preview page.route interception of POST https://safequake.onrender.com/api/status works reliably. Grant geolocation + notifications permissions on context and set_geolocation to desired coords BEFORE clicking trigger (so alert.tsx warm-up watcher picks up the mocked fix within its 15s freshness window). Selector `[data-testid="trigger-alert-btn"]` may resolve to 2 elements briefly during expo-router transition off the alert screen; use `query_selector_all` count or `[data-testid="alert-screen"]` absence instead of waiting for trigger button post-safe. Native OS-level notification delivery cannot be verified on web preview — only that scheduleCheckInReminders/cancelCheckInReminders are invoked.
